test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 14 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘BAE’ is written as ‘512’ and ‘WIN’ is written as ‘14923’. How will ‘HER’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b15de16d396b52c68424915920e099dae05b94ac6a08cd00b03ee850fcc8e27.png] 

The logic followed here is:

‘BAE’ is written as ‘512’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cac9a087cde0a6b4793ce0abc8e7613ac8d13f4b41fe287ee0dcc9d69251eb30.png] 

‘WIN’ is written as ‘14923’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3312fa0f76924b90131da60cf4e0353eedaee4a7226f2b338a39f1993b349b.png] 

Similarly, ‘**HER**’ will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eee37c043c46aab96ac0097350707de1da47b76da68d680965d3504bd849732b.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**1858**".
